source_accuracy_findings: The2006 account supports the reported acquisition chronology and distinguishes an upper-margin fragment, joined B/C and an indecipherable cluster. Footnote8 reports later gluing rather than an original observed join. Provenance remains the edition's account, not this project's excavation/authentication.

The2006p58 layout supports A1–4 and B+C i8–15 mapping; the intervening missing lines explain the numbering. QDR ii12 is additional to the modern main text. The A4 letter discrepancy is real and held, not normalized into agreement.

Entirely supplied i16 and the bracketed verse19 continuation in ii16 do not establish surviving verse19. The p59 reference actually prints23:4; word/context and passage tagging support the report's explicitly identified intended23:42 locus. Plene spelling does not create a new English sense.

The seven P1038B mappings agree with the actual publisher figure index, including explicit uncertainty in the relevant proposed Judges passages and the Judges-or-Leviticus alternative for fragment8. This is a locator crosswalk; the absent body argument and images prevent promotion to secure whole-scroll identification.

The two11QpapLev main lines contain only the short reported unbracketed sequences amid extensive supply.11Q28's unlocated older frg1 unit and proposed fragment readings remain separate holds. Parallel texts are not extra surviving letters or identity links.
Tigchelaar's box988 report and IAA's plate988a fragment6 metadata are faithfully distinguished from the later P1038B series. Equal fragment numbers supply no defensible inventory bridge.

The report preserves shared-edition/Abegg ancestry as the strongest counter-explanation to independent digital corroboration. It neither inflates manuscript counts nor infers forgery from the X label or discovery date.
Access failures are labeled failures, published illustrations are not called new original photographs, and copyright/license boundaries do not imply public photograph redistribution.
